test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 9 Nov 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select ‘No substitution required’.

This is __the worse__ famine this country has seen in a decade.
solution:
The correct answer is-'the worst'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The correct word to substitute the word '**the worse**' is '**the worst**'.
 
• Worst: It is the superlative degree of the word '**bad**'. It refers to 'the least well'.
 
• It is always used after **'the'****.**
 
• Hence, the most appropriate option to substitute is 'the worst'.
 
• Thus, *option 4 *is the correct answer.

 

The correct sentence is:* **This is **the worst__** famine this country has seen in a decade.*
